setupWizard.title: Set up your printers
setupWizard.discardText: Your changes to printers, filaments or the default engine are not saved yet.
setupWizard.pickPrinterFirst: Pick a printer first: the filaments listed are the ones your printers have.
setupWizard.engineExplain: New projects start with this engine. You can still pick the other one for any project: use Slicer engine above the printer. A project you open uses the engine it was made with.
setupWizard.noPrinters: No printers. Pick at least one below.
setupWizard.printersIntro: Pick each printer you have and its nozzle sizes in mm (you can change this later with Manage). Every printer slices here;
setupWizard.printersIntroAfter: marks the ones this app can also send prints to and start (Klipper printers, Prusa printers through PrusaLink, the Elegoo Centauri Carbon, and Bambu Lab printers with Developer Mode on). For the others you download the G-code, or send it through OctoPrint if OctoPrint runs the printer.
setupWizard.directTip: Direct print: this app sends prints to it and starts them from the Device tab (Klipper with Moonraker, Prusa with PrusaLink, the Elegoo Centauri Carbon, or Bambu Lab with Developer Mode on)
setupWizard.pickFilaments: Pick the filaments you use. The filament pickers will offer only these.
setupWizard.connectExplain: To send prints and watch them, add how to reach each printer: its address on your network (through a small bridge) or a public https address. You can do this now or later in the Device tab.
setupWizard.welcomeText: Sign in to get your printers, presets and projects.
